description: This file defines a React component for a streaming export modal, handling export progress, success, error, and download actions within the Apache Superset project.

classes.name: ModalStateContent
classes.description: A React component that displays the current state of the export process, including progress bar, icons, messages, and action buttons.

methods.name: triggerFileDownload
methods.description: Creates a temporary link to trigger a file download from a URL.

methods.name: calculateProgressPercentage
methods.description: Calculates the progress percentage based on total rows and rows processed.

methods.name: getProgressStatus
methods.description: Returns the progress bar status ('success', 'exception', 'normal') based on export status.

methods.name: getMessageText
methods.description: Generates user-facing message text based on export status, filename, and error.

methods.name: getButtonText
methods.description: Determines the label for the modal's action button based on export status.
